prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Sign In to Save & Sync Your Pet", "Your pet customization and companion progress stay backed up and available across all your desktop devices."]
1: ["Choose Your Pet Companion", "Select a pet template to preview its desktop personality and traits."]
2: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Choose an instant standard pet template or generate a custom pet from your own photos.", "Instant Adoption vs AI Photo Customization"]
3: ["Verifying Desktop Permissions", "Ensuring the screen overlay renderer and background service are ready to display your pet.", "Checking desktop window permissions..."]
4: ["Your Pet is Ready!", "Drag your pet across your screen or right-click its system tray icon to hide, feed, or adjust settings."]
5: ["Photo Preparation Checklist", "For best pet generation, use well-lit photos with clear subject framing."]
6: []
7: ["Building Your Pet's Desktop Environment", "Extracting animations, interactions, and background rendering engine components.", "Loading pet graphics and sound assets..."]
8: ["Bring Your Desktop to Life", "Adopt an interactive screen companion that plays, wanders, and keeps you company while you work."]
9: ["Quick tip: Click your system tray icon anytime to minimize, summon, or open your pet's menu."]
